verdict.summary: The opt-in exclusivity control is sound and fail-closed: declarations are anchored to standalone comment lines, malformed or duplicate declarations raise, claimants absent from the independently derived schedule map fail, every overlap with every other scheduled lane is enumerated, and the live seam prevents the current two load-bearing declarations from disappearing or becoming vacuous. The changed schedules currently satisfy both declarations, and the tests exercise the important positive, negative, partial-overlap, empty-map, empty-claim, duplicate, and missing-tree cases. Two touched workflow files retain legacy model-qualified provenance headers; these are minor repository-hygiene issues and do not undermine the control.
